meta.source: Derived from the state-1 screens of the E2E run dashboard canvas and the palette of its sibling tool (QA/e2e/viewer).

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. Also the inset ground of inputs and code blocks inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels and cards.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Job rows in the scenario table; selected filter chips' ground is info-bg instead.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Empty track of progress and time bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, section dividers, table header rule.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row separators inside tables and the log.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Chip and pill outlines, dashed empty states, kbd keys. 3:1 against surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary body text: scenario ids, notes, log lines.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, eyebrows, meta lines, units. ≥5.5:1 on surface-1 in both themes, so safe at 11px.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: the dots between id segments, part dividers. Never for words.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and the focus ring. Links always open in a new tab.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected filter chip.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a selected filter chip.

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: Running: the live pill, the now line, the running bar and ▶. Paired with the word or ▶, never alone.

tokens.name: run-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Running pill and of the running row.

tokens.name: run-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the phase chip in the Now panel.

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: The ✓ glyph of a passed result. Text stays ink; only the glyph is coloured.

tokens.name: pass-fill
tokens.usage: Actual-time bars of finished jobs on the plan timeline.

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Failure: ✕, failed counts, the failure panel's edge. The only loud colour on a healthy page.

tokens.name: fail-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a failed row and of the Failed pill.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: the outline, label and glyph of a needs-you card, and the Paused / Stuck pills.

tokens.name: needs-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a needs-you card.

tokens.name: finding
tokens.usage: Label and ◆ of a finding (a suspected app bug) from the agent.

tokens.name: finding-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a finding card.

tokens.name: finding-line
tokens.usage: Outline of a finding card.

tokens.name: estimate-line
tokens.usage: Outline of an estimate box on the timeline: solid when measured, dashed when guessed. 3:1 on surface-1.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Stroke of the diagonal hatch that marks wallet setup time.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one answer of a panel: when part 1 ends, scenarios done. Tabular figures.

styles.name: figure-m
styles.usage: The second answer under a figure-xl.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Final validation of receive, payments and history
styles.usage: The run name in the header (16px on phone).

styles.name: small
styles.sample: 3 h 32 min of work left, if parts 2 and 3 are resumed at once.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Panel labels, in capitals, in ink-dim.

styles.name: id-s
styles.usage: Commands to copy, log times, meta lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to word; between id segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and pills; between list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items inside a panel; table cell gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between panels; phone page padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between header groups.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Desktop page side padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Timeline bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, selects.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Strips and small cards: needs-you, messages.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, tag chips, filter chips.

tokens.name: size-bar-run
tokens.usage: Height of the run progress bar (8px on phone).

tokens.name: size-bar-step
tokens.usage: Height of the elapsed-against-expected bar.

tokens.name: size-timeline-row
tokens.usage: One job row on the desktop timeline.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on phone.

tokens.name: size-shot-w
tokens.usage: Width of the phone-screenshot slot (9:20 portrait; 64px on phone).

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone design width. The first 844px must answer questions 1–4.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop design width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop content column (1440 minus two space-14).
